title: My Dark Fantasy RPG - what do you think? 100% AI build
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
I used a new image-to-game skill to get the game visuals right, and then been adding mechanics to it,

it's a bit wonky still but what do you think about the style of the game?

Build time was about 4 hours, token cost around $20

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body:
what did you use that cost $20?  
i love the concept, i can see the vision. i dont like the choppy frames but thats all fixable haha.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
I tried a new image-to-game AI on this page: 

https://tesana.ai/explore

Found a dark fantasy art that I really liked and used that as visual reference for the build

comments.author: r0b0c0p87
comments.body: That's a really cool style. Good luck!

replies.body: Thank you!

comments.author: Ok-Hotel-8551

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: I did 60 yesterday using image references 😵

replies.author: Ok-Hotel-8551
replies.body: 60 games per day? Why didn't you focus on1 or 2?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Just trying out visual styles and having fun, will probably focus on one or two of the coolest ones

Takes about 5 mins to turn the image into a game so I can try alot

replies.author: Ok-Hotel-8551
replies.body: 60 games, token costs around 20 dollars, that's 1200 dollars per day. Give hobby you have there.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Well this game was 40 prompts, the others I haven’t gotten that far yet. Just using the image to game feature which isn’t that expensive to get a first output
